name: Békéscsaba municipal map colored neighborhood footprints

properties.name: Erzsébethely (Jamina)

controlPoints.method: Affine fit of the image municipality outline to the actual OSM municipal boundary in EPSG23700

reviewNotes: Boundaries follow the six actual colored footprints of the municipal image; rural cyan regions are not attributed by proximity.

Color-mask classification and five-pixel closing fill text/road interruptions; boundary uncertainty is at least3sourcepixels. Tiny central-mask overlaps at touching brightgreen/teal footprints are removed with those distinct color footprints taking priority.
No Google basemap geometry is used. Municipal map image is independent of the Google iframe on its landing page.
The raster map has no publication date and no established reuse license; this remains an auditable research artifact.
